item.title: Orga Fighter Ayana -Departure-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shoku KING-Kai, ONEONE1
  • 発売日: 2013-07-05
  • スコア: 6.68/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: オルガファイターAYANA―Departure―
  • 英語名: Orga Fighter Ayana -Departure-

あらすじ

Ayana Kirisaki, the hentai bishoujo who loves sex. Born of tentacle origin she will go on fulfill the legend of her species, and fight as an Orga Knight in defense of her galaxy and tentacle planet.

But today…

Ayana has no idea of the future. She’s just an ordinary schoolgirl living an ordinary life in Neo Tokyo.
